artifact_observations.location: Text on both red and white boxes
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the packaging is nonsensical. The left box has red lettering that mimics Latin script but forms no real words. The right box has text that resembles Cyrillic or Greek characters but is structurally malformed and unreadable. This is a classic AI generation artifact where the model mimics the shape of text without understanding orthography.
The boxes have an overly smooth, plastic-like sheen that lacks the subtle cardboard texture expected of pharmaceutical packaging. The lighting reflections are slightly diffuse and unnatural.
The perspective lines of the right box are slightly inconsistent; the top edge and bottom edge do not converge perfectly parallel to the vanishing point, giving it a slight 'warped' look.
